title: WiFi 6 AX1800 PoE Dual Band Multi-Gig Indoor/Outdoor Access Point

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your wireless network with the WiFi 6 AX1800 PoE Dual Band Multi-Gig Indoor/Outdoor Access Point, designed to deliver faster speeds, higher capacity, and reliable coverage in both indoor and outdoor environments. Powered by 802.11ax (WiFi 6) technology, this access point ensures smooth performance for high-density users, making it ideal for offices, campuses, warehouses, hotels, and outdoor public areas.


With PoE support and a Multi-Gig Ethernet port, installation is simple while ensuring high-speed backhaul and stable connectivity.


Key Features


  • Wireless Standard: WiFi 6 (IEEE 802.11ax)
  • Speed Class: AX1800
  • Bands: Dual Band (2.4GHz & 5GHz)
  • PoE Support: IEEE 802.3af / 802.3at
  • Ethernet Port: Multi-Gig (2.5GbE)
  • Indoor/Outdoor Use: Weather-resistant design
  • MU-MIMO & OFDMA: Supports high-density connections
  • Seamless Roaming: Enhanced performance for multiple clients
  • Mounting Options: Wall & ceiling mount
